messages:
maya: Quick sync — proposing final rollout checkpoint for v2.14.6 this Thursday. Need eyes on the window alignment for US / EU / APAC before I lock schedules.

sam: Proposed windows (local times): US canary 09:00-11:00 PDT, EU canary 18:00-20:00 CEST, APAC canary 02:00-04:00 JST. These give 2h buffer between canaries for log sync. @maya

jen: QA note: we need at least 90m after each canary for regression smoke and obs checks. EU time is tight if we start at 18:00 CEST (team shift). Can we move EU to 17:30? :thinking:

arjun: SRE: routing and fallback policies look good. One operational ask — if EU canary bumps latency, auto-fallback to the lighter-quant model should kick in. I'll add the policy to the rollout config.

lee: Dev: changelog bump and version tag in PR #3321 are ready. Please do not merge until cutoff at 16:00 UTC Wednesday. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/3321 :shipit:

maya: Confirming cutoff: 16:00 UTC Wed for branch freeze, docs and changelog must be merged by then. After cutoff it's emergency-only commits.

jen: QA ack — will prioritize EU regression tests before cutoff. Can we get a short runbook snippet for the APAC overnight window?

maya: I'll draft the runbook in the release doc and ping here. Basic steps: 1) start canary, 2) watch latency & error-rate dashboards for 30m, 3) promote if stable, 4) run smoke regressions.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary targets created for v2.14.6: us-west-2 (canary), eu-central-1 (canary), ap-northeast-1 (canary). Canary window placeholders pending final times.

arjun: Ops check — confirm database migration is NOOP for canary. If any schema change is included it must be gating behind feature flag.

lee: Confirmed: no schema changes in this release. Feature flags added for the opt-in routing in PR #3321.

maya: OK locking windows: US 09:00-11:00 PDT, EU 17:30-19:30 CEST, APAC 02:00-04:00 JST. Cutoff 16:00 UTC Wed. QA regression windows set to 90m after canary each region. If no objections I'll update the calendar and release doc in 30m. :calendar:

docs-bot: Release doc updated: https://docs.internal/releases/v2.14.6 — includes windows, runbook checklist, and rollback instructions.

sam: Small ask: add a note to the runbook about quick token/secret rotation step for Dedicated customers during rollout.

maya: Good call, added. Thanks all — I'll post the final calendar invite and set the branch protection rules at cutoff.

jen: Thanks — will standby during EU window, ping me once canary starts. :eyes:

lee: Merging changelog PR right after cutoff. Good luck everyone.

maya: End of thread — will reopen if anything changes.
